title: Provider Manual: Re-Evaluation Units When a Prior Authorization Changes Provider
content:
### Provider manual — re-evaluation by the new servicing provider (Prior Authorization)

**Section rule.** The re-evaluation reduction of a provider change of a Prairie Ridge Prior Authorization approval counts the days from the latest use posted on the approval (or from the approval's start date where no use is posted) to the day of the change: more than 30 days takes off 2 units for the new provider's re-evaluation; 8 to 30 days takes off 1 unit; 7 days or fewer takes off nothing.

The reduction is a whole number of units, taken once from the units the provider change carries over, which are never below zero.

**Counting the days.** The count starts at the service date of the latest use posted on the approval and runs to the day of the change; a change the day after that service date counts 1 day. Where no use is posted on the approval, the count starts at the approval's start date.

| Days from the latest posted use (or start date) to the change | Units taken off |
|---|---|
| 0 to 7 | 0 |
| 8 to 30 | 1 |
| 31 or more | 2 |

**Boundary pairs (hypothetical, for illustration only).**

- Latest use 7 days before the change: nothing is taken off. Latest use 8 days before: 1 unit.
- Latest use 30 days before the change: 1 unit. Latest use 31 days before: 2 units.
- No use posted and the approval started 45 days before the change: 2 units.
